scope: Assigned frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, local rendered HTML, capture receipts, and every assigned screenshot tile; no live routes.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; WORKFLOW.md and tools/autopilot/AUDIT.md read for rendering-audit context.
review_method.rendering: Every assigned local PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or downscaling.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every assigned frozen title and full ItemBody was reviewed in the snapshot and compared with its byte-identical current source, assigned HTML, capture receipt, and screenshot tiles.
review_method.boundary: No item, application, or publication-status edits; no builds, tests, gates, commits, pushes, or network calls. Only topology/lane-09.md and topology/lane-09.json were written.

findings.evidence: The proof paragraph ends with “∎ ## Remarks” on the same source line; the local HTML and screenshot tile --03 render the heading marker literally inside the proof paragraph instead of as a heading. The following remarks text is separate.
findings.recommendation: Start “## Remarks” on a new line after the proof paragraph.

findings.rationale: This example is explicitly an octagon surface schema. The text gives all eight cyclic sides, the affine-reversal side identifications, and the quotient realization; a labeled polygon is central to how a reader understands the gluing and the genus-two surface.
findings.concrete_content: Draw the convex octagon with vertices v_0,…,v_7; label the boundary a,b,a^{-1},b^{-1},c,d,c^{-1},d^{-1}; pair each inverse-labeled side by the stated affine reversal; indicate q:P→Y=P/R and Y≅T^2#T^2. Preserve the stated counts V=1,E=4,F=1 and do not use the diagram as proof.
